verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Lord, we're reaching for the hem of Your garment
Oh Jesus, we lift our eyes to You
Son of David, do not pass us by
We long for Your return, we long for You
We long for Your return, we long for You

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Lord, we need You
Send the winds of refreshing, winds of refreshing
Lord, we need You here

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Lord, we know You are healer
Lord, we know You are deliverer
Lord, we know You are savior
So come and heal, deliver, and save
